name: JUDAO
rootCause: JUDAO sell-hook reserve drain. Lost: 205K USDT + 36 BNB

descriptions.text: JUDAO sell-hook reserve drain. Lost: 205K USDT + 36 BNB

The JUDAO token / liquidity pool on BSC was exploited via Flashloan-assisted Manipulation. The attacker used flash loans to manipulate pool reserves or pricing, draining funds through PancakeSwap V2 routes (e.g., BUSD-JUDAO pair). Losses included at least 205,259 USDT plus 36 BNB.

JUDAO's T3 token on BNB Chain was exploited on April 28, 2026, through a flawed ERC-20 sell-transfer hook. The attacker manipulated PancakeSwap pair reserves to withdraw 205,259 USDT and 36 BNB (~$227.9K) from the liquidity pool. The exploit abused tokenomics logic that debited pair tokens and updated reserves mid-transfer, breaking AMM accounting assumptions. JUDAO's sell-transfer hook performed reserve manipulations and sync() calls inside the transfer logic, causing a mismatch between actual token balances and stored reserves. The vulnerable implementation allowed the attacker to create excess sellable reserves and extract more USDT than permitted by normal swap pricing.
